description: Per-execution budgets enforced in the kernel: every second execution of the shared MCP server gets a budget, kept with its usage in BPF maps by the policy (connections: counted at cgroup/connect4; sent bytes: the bytes tcp_sendmsg/udp_sendmsg accepted, charged at their return by fexit programs and checked at every send by the BPF LSM program). Tools: async (new connection per call, budget of 10 connections) and httpx_shared (keep-alive pool shared by the sessions, budget of 1500 sent bytes). Budget mode 2 (usage counted in the kernel, nothing denied) and 1 (counted and enforced). Reference: the destination's per-request log (bytes) and the outcome of each call at the client (connections).
